name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires picking up the box, but the clauses only require `door_open`; `Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up)` restricts when the box may be picked up and does not require it. Add a hard `Existence(target_picked_up)`.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(door_open) repeats what hard Existence(target_picked_up) with hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already forces. Remove Existence(door_open); keep the target goal and its required order.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires picking up the box, and hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) requires opening the door before doing so.

texts: Open the door before picking up the box.
